text:
Priya: quick sync — proposing a new 'Guidance Engine' slice for Optimize toolkit: automated batching/caching/quantization recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. want to carve an MVP and agree on launch gates.
Sam: high level — love it. can you sketch what the API & UX look like for customers? also metrics we should use to measure impact.
Priya: sure — MVP surfaces: 1) Recommendations API (per-route model + config suggestions) 2) Offline weekly report (CSV + UI) 3) Eval hook that triggers alerts on quality or perf regressions. Metrics: token cost delta, p95/p99 latency, inference throughput (tokens/sec), eval concordance.
June: +1. suggest guardrails: recommendations should include estimated impact with confidence band and a safety flag when quantization risks output fidelity. basic UI mock: compact card with "what to change", "expected savings", "risk".
Li: infra note — real-time recommendations are expensive. for MVP do offline analysis from traffic samples. we'll need sampling job + prefix/KV cache stats + model perf profiles. estimate 2-3 infra nodes for pilot.
Nora: customer asks — payments + search teams want batching heuristics and cache TTL recs. Compliance teams: private deploy must keep request payloads in customer VPC. how do we obfuscate prompts?
Priya: design decision: defaults: 1) Hosted: anonymized signatures + metrics allowed 2) Dedicated/private: run analyzer in-customer VPC (container image) or operate on metadata only. no raw prompts leave by default.
Sam: API sketch (very rough):
```json
POST /v1/optimize/recommendations
{ "route": "my-app/complete", "sample_window": "24h", "constraints": {"max_latency_ms": 300} }

Response: { "recommendations": [{"type":"batch_size","value":16,"estimated_savings_pct":12,"confidence":0.7}, ...] }
```
June: love the shape. can we include a reversible-suggest flag so engineers can apply suggestion and auto-rollback if eval falls?
Priya: yes — MVP should include a canary + auto-fallback policy: apply to 5% traffic, monitor eval signals for 48h, auto-revert on regression.
Li: infra will need a canary path in routing, + short retention of KV cache metrics. also quantization profiling requires sample inputs; agree to do it offline.
Nora: pilot customers — can we invite 3 teams: payments, search, and a platform team? they'll validate batching heuristics across different SLA needs.
Sam: acceptance criteria proposal:
- Produces actionable recs for at least 3 route archetypes (chat, short-complete, embed)
- Demonstrates >=10% token cost reduction for >=2 pilot customers without >5% user-visible quality delta
- Eval-triggered alerts surface regressions within 1 hour of deployment change
- Can rollback automated changes within 2 hours of detected regression
June: add security/compliance gate: private deployment path must pass simple KMS/HSM proof-of-run and not export prompt text.
Priya: timeline suggestion:
- spec + infra estimate: 2 weeks (owners: Sam, Li)
- pilot connector + offline report: 4 weeks (owner: Sam)
- canary + eval hooks: 6 weeks (owner: June)
- pilot run with 3 customers: weeks 8–12, then decision for GA in Q4.
Li: resource ask: 2 infra engineers (0.5 FTE each) + 1 infra SRE on call for the canary window. estimate infra cost ~ $6k/mo for pilot.
Nora: I'll line up pilot contacts, need a short intake doc to share constraints and telemetry we need.
Priya: action items: Sam -> draft API + example responses by 2026-04-03, Li -> infra cost + sampling plan by 2026-04-03, June -> draft eval alert rules & rollback logic by 2026-04-06, Nora -> pilot intake doc by 2026-04-06.
Sam: I'll start a small swagger and a sample CSV layout for the offline report.
June: question — quantization recs: do we recommend specific quant levels or only profiles? quant can break output; want conservative defaults.
Priya: MVP: profiles + safe presets (e.g., q4_0, q8_0) with recommended validation steps; advanced per-model quant tuning later.
Nora: thumbs up from customers I've chatted with if rollout is gradual and reversible. :thumbsup:
DevBot: deploy-bot: created workspace optimize-guidance/mvp-draft (#42) — commit queued.
Priya: ok wrap — feels like consensus on scope + guards. leaving this thread as spec backbone. we'll sync tomorrow 10am to unblock owners.
Sam: ack.
June: ack :calendar:
Li: ack — I'll post infra sketch in this thread when ready.
Nora: thanks, everyone.
Priya: thanks — marking this as the working doc for now.
